list_repository_files: list the contents of a directory in a Hugging Face Hub repository using the hf:// protocol
read_remote_file: read a file from a Hugging Face Hub repository as if it were a local file system
write_remote_file: write data to a remote file in a Hugging Face Hub repository with automatic commit
delete_remote_file: delete one or more files from a Hugging Face Hub repository recursively
copy_remote_file: copy a file within or between Hugging Face Hub repositories using the file system interface
